notes.content:
[list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.04 - Puzzle updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added minor hints for puzzles relating to endings 5, 9 and 11 in world.

[*]Re-worked ending 12 puzzle to only rely on information in the game.
[*]Removed tedious exploration related to ending 12 puzzle.
[/list]
